avis.texte: I’ve been using these pads as part of my acne routine, and so far I’ve had a positive experience with them. The pads feel nice on my skin and leave me feeling like my face is actually getting cleaned. Since using them, I’ve noticed an improvement in both my facial and body acne. Areas that were previously red and inflamed have become flatter and less noticeable over time. That said, I’m also using a face/body wash and the occasional spot treatment, so I can’t say these pads are solely responsible for the improvement. However, they’ve been a consistent part of my routine and seem to be helping. I still get the occasional breakout, especially during stressful periods, but the blemishes don’t seem to stick around as long as they used to. Overall, these have worked well for me and I’ll continue using them.

I will be recommending this to anyone and everyone. I have dry and sensitive skin and these work wonders for me. This is the clearest my skin has been in years and they smell good too. I use one every day and it’s perfect for me. The pads have enough texture that I can scrub my face, but not too much to leave scratches like other ones I’ve tried. Will be reordering in the future!
